name: car_sedan_pipes
source: ps_audio A11 (out/audio_plan.md section 9 row A11, owner ruling 2026-09-29 'can I drive the same engine that drives the audio?'): data/vehicles/car_sedan_sim.json with its engine swapped for engines/demo_i4_pipes.json - the SAME [AS] generic 2.0 L naturally-aspirated I4 with intake/exhaust pipe blocks that ps_audio's tools/ps_engine_audio demo (A10) and adapters/godot's live voice (A11) render. NOT a real engine, and NOT the Toyota A25A car_sedan_sim.json drives - every geometry/table value in demo_i4_pipes.json is a plausible, unmeasured [AS] guess (see that file's own 'source'). The point of this file is that physics (the mean-value VE/eta_i/friction maps, generated at vehicle-load time from demo_i4_pipes.json's 'cycle' block through the existing I7c C16a loader path, cached to a .psmaps directory by the caller's EngineMapOptions so a repeat launch does not pay the generation cost again) and sound (the SAME 'cycle' block's live pipe-network model, ps_audio A11) come from ONE engine description - no separate 'sound engine' override. Chassis/gearbox/final-drive/tyres/brakes/aero/steering/tcu blocks are car_sedan_sim.json's, unchanged (same 60/40 static split, same sedan_6mt gearbox, same auto-clutch/auto-blip tuning). Clutch: capacity kept at car_sedan.json's original 300 N*m / static_factor 1.15 (NOT car_sedan_sim.json's 350 N*m) - demo_i4_pipes.json is a generic 2.0 L NA four in the same class as car_sedan.json's own engines/i4_2l_na.json (bore/stroke 86/86 mm ~= 2.0 L, CR 10.5, vs. i4_2l_na.json's own torque curve), not the larger, higher-torque 2.5 L A25A car_sedan_sim.json was tuned for, so car_sedan.json's original clutch margin (1.5x its engine's peak torque, from that file's own 'source' field) is the better-fitting reuse. Checked (tests/validation/test_car_sedan_pipes.cpp): idles without stalling, a full-throttle 1st-gear launch from rest does not stall and reaches forward speed (measured 12.08 m/s at 3 s, comparable to car_sedan.json's own reference launch), and a neutral free rev reaches the demo engine's fuel-cut limiter band (6800 rpm, hysteresis 150, measured peak 6809.7) and falls back below it (measured 4170.7 rpm one second after lift) - the same three checks test_reference_cars.cpp/test_powertrain_engine.cpp use elsewhere, run once here because this is the first vehicle to drive a pipe-network simulated engine instead of a torque-map or measured-map one. Idle (idle_pipes task, 2026-09-29, fixed in engines/demo_i4_pipes.json, data only - see that file's 'source' for the four causes and the discriminating runs): settles at 800 rpm, last 2 s of a 10 s idle range 0.653 rpm, mean 800.054, inside +-10 rpm from 3.05 s (was a ~1040-1300 rpm hunt).
